category: Medical & Dental Questions > Dental English Questions

questions.question: A person who is indifferent to both pleasure and pain is called-
questions.explanation:
Saint দরবেশ।
Hermit - সন্ন্যাসী।
Ascetic যে ব্যক্তি ধর্মীয় কারণে কঠোর আত্মশৃঙ্খলা মেনে চলে।

questions.question: Which of the following words is in singular form?
questions.explanation:
Singular-Plural 
Agendum - Agenda
Formula - Formulae
Oasis - Oases
Radius - Radii

questions.question: Which plural word can be used as a singular?
questions.explanation:
Singular-Plural
Book - Books
University - Universities
Prince - Princes
Ethics দেখতে Plural কিন্তু Singular।

questions.question: The number of auxiliary verbs in English is-
questions.explanation:
Auxiliary Verb 12টি
1. Be verb ১টি
2. Have verb ১টি
3. Do verb ১টি
4. Modal verb ৯টি

questions.question: What kind of noun is' discipline'?
The meaning of "to play fair"?
questions.explanation: To play fair - ন্যায্যভাবে করা অর্থাৎ প্রতারণা না করা (To avoid cheating)

questions.question: Education is the most pressing need of the time. Here the word 'pressing' is:
questions.explanation: Need হলো noun, এর আগে pressing শব্দটি Present participle / Verbal adjective হিসেবে বসেছে

questions.question: Which one of the following is a demonstrative pronoun?
questions.explanation: Demonstrative Pronoun হলো This, These, That, Those, so, such, the same etc.

questions.question: What is the meaning of "out of the woods"?
questions.explanation: Out of the woods অর্থ- বিপদমুক্ত।

questions.question: To talk disrespectfully of sacred things is called-
questions.explanation:
Apostasy - স্বধর্মত্যাগী
Heresy - নব্যতন্ত্র
Atheism - নাস্তিকতা

questions.question: Fire burns. What kind of verb is 'burn'?
questions.explanation: এখানে burn verb এর object না থাকায় এটি intransitive verb.
